issue.title: Bug: Mismatch scope of DUT and ASIC fixtures

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

The scope of DUT and ASIC enum fixtures (e.g. enum_rand_one_frontend_asic_index) are set to be module in current code upon definitions. However, the values of those fixtures are generated by `pytest_generate_tests` function which is executed once for every test function in the module.

Some other fixtures depending on these enum fixtures, such as `ip_netns_namespace_prefix` and `selected_asic_index`, follows the scope definition of those enum fixtures. So, their values are only set once per module. Such a behavior can cause inconsistency between the enum fixtures and the dependent fixtures, resulting in test failures. For example, in the test run of generic_config_updater/test_cacl.py on t1-8-lag multi-asic KVM testbed, I saw the following failure:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/06750b1e-6f1c-4061-a178-e507a2b9eb42)

In the scenario above, ip_netns_namespace_prefix points to asic1 while enum_rand_one_frontend_asic_index points to 0(asic0).

### Steps to Reproduce

Run generic_config_updater/test_cacl.py on multi-asic testbed several times.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual Behavior: mismatch ASIC namespaces in different fixtures
Expect Behavior: consistent ASIC namespaces across all fixtures

resolution.title: Change the generation of enum random ASIC fixtures to be done once per module
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary: The value of random ASIC enum fixtures is now generated once per function, which does not match the scope definition of the fixture (module level). In this PR, I restrict the generation of the value of the fixtures to be done once per module.
Fixes #18422 (issue)
